g.text: Regional DID sensitivity | Q5 versus Q1–Q4
Top: disclosed-occupation support screens, original quintile cutoffs frozen. Bottom: same 193-region / 18-country cohort; only weight year changes.
Bars are nominal country-clustered CR1-type t intervals; printed p-values use restricted country wild bootstrap. These are different inference procedures.
No primary or screened estimate establishes a causal AI effect. Weight-year youth p=.0497 becomes Holm p=.4473 across nine weight diagnostics.
